heckman.reason: Not identified. Heckman (1979) needs an exclusion restriction, and the Chicago inspections file has none: closing, a missing re-inspection, and a keyword miss are not separable from the survival outcome, and applications that never opened are not in the file.

conformal.note: Split conformal interval (Vovk, Gammerman and Shafer 2005) around the leave-one-area citywide survivor share. This is not an interval for a stored Qloo fit score.
